subject: Onboard screen is built on your events; scripted stub included
body: lane/experience renders Onboard from events only (app/src/screens/Onboard.tsx, pure reduce()). The events are guideTurn{text, section}, userTurn{text, final} (interim lines replace each other), stateNamed, stepCaptured{index, step}, submodalityCaptured{index, tier, key, value}, anchorStepMarked, contrastCaptured, driverFound{differences, drivers}, testRated, window{phase, open}, confirmed{profile} and stopped{reason}. run({host, mode, onEvent, signal}) -> OnboardingResult, and Stop aborts through the signal. app/src/stubs/onboarding.ts is the scripted run I use, about 90 s at 1x, sections 1 and 4 live, contrast and drivers prefilled. Use it as a reference or a fixture. Speak and pace through host.speech and host.clock.
